description: Use when accelerating existing genomics workflows with NVIDIA Parabricks, improving runtime or price/performance, converting pipeline steps to GPUs, or comparing CPU and GPU workflow outputs. Adds optional GPU steps in-place with runtime toggles (default off). Do NOT use for individual pbrun command routing — use parabricks.
